Context: 13. Annual Return of Assets and Liabilities

13. NOTE 1.- Individual items of loans not exceeding two months' basic pay or t 1 lakh in other items, should not be included.
14. NOTE 2.- Loans and advances (exceeding two months' basic pay and t 1 lakh in other items) taken from banks, companies, financial institutions, Central/State Government and from individuals should be included.
